profile: release / fat LTO / one codegen unit
notes: After PR #171 merged, the branch was rebased onto main at 08e730f. The engine-rapier, engine-terrain, Scorched Earth, Spacewars and Terrain Lab source trees are byte-identical to the tested runtime 5d02c6d. Runtime revisions and binary hashes below retain their actual build provenance; the Picade deployment predates the rebase.

Final recovery planner: ordinary successful placements retained, recovery only after 1.5 seconds quiet, up to three alternate assignments, at most eight surface reconstructions per group, at most 64 candidate grains per tick.
Collapse-enabled deposition rejects newly oversteep cells using the same local gravity/repose rule as yielding. Normal collapse-off placement has no slope constraint.
Three serial desktop repetitions for each before/after Scorched mode; one serial Picade run per mode. Spacewars and existing benchmark timings are single-run smoke comparisons.
Scorched seed 42: 120 simulated seconds, 60 seconds bombardment and a 60-second tail, 192 grains, full replay with per-second hashes. Timing excludes audits, observations, replay and rendering.
Picade kiosk pause checked before and after each run. Endpoint telemetry is temperature in millidegrees C, frequency in kHz, and undervoltage alarm; it cannot rule out intervening throttling.
Baseline binaries came from PR #171 runtime b1c6a58; branch base 651ae25 adds docs and a formatting fix only.
Frozen inspection isolates the packing decision and does not mutate the source simulation. New captures include optional repose samples.
Collapse remains optional: the combined feature has mixed outcomes and regressions in some scenes. No general complete-settling or frame-budget guarantee is claimed.
